references.text: Barak was called to gather men from Zebulun and Naphtali for the battle against Sisera, showing the military role of the tribes.
Zebulun and Naphtali gathered at Mount Tabor to fight, confirming their bravery described in the song.
The context describes which tribes participated in the war and highlights the courageous efforts of Zebulun and Naphtali.
Moses' blessing over Naphtali describes the tribe as full of the Lord's favor, which is reflected in their bravery.
The lands of Zebulun and Naphtali are mentioned as areas that will be honored, despite earlier humiliation.
The expression about risking one's life for the Lord's sake reflects Zebulun's and Naphtali's willingness to die in battle.
Believers who did not love their lives so much as to fear death reflect the tribes' readiness to sacrifice themselves in battle.
